description.fr-FR: Les discours de controverse (mission des pasteurs, sacrifice de la messe, présence réelle), les discours sur l’Eucharistie et les opuscules contre les hérétiques.
description.en-US: The controversy discourses (the mission of pastors, the sacrifice of the Mass, the real presence), the discourses on the Eucharist and the minor writings against the heretics.
description.pt-BR: Os discursos de controvérsia (missão dos pastores, sacrifício da missa, presença real), os discursos sobre a Eucaristia e os opúsculos contra os hereges.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du cardinal de Bérulle, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856 (reprint of Bourgoing’s 1644 collected edition); archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors, merged columns and some chapter openings the scan lost remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Bérulle died in 1629; the 1856 edition is public domain.
